answer: Sybil farms often share one operator clock. Mechanism: assign a numbered irrigation terrace and plant a live willow cutting at stake S. A public pulse beacon fires every 7 min; within 90 s measure sap-flow at a marked internodal cut and post H(pubkey||terrace_id||pulse_seq||sap_uL). Cost is 74 locked units. Three peers replay the next two pulses on-site and drop any flow already bound to a live terrace. A sap miss over 12%, a late pulse reply, or a reused terrace-id burns 22 units and cools the key six epochs; a second miss or cloned sap log forfeits the lock for 14 epochs.
